`create_model` computes `flat` but never converts `sns`, which remains the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. Although `_snapshots_parameter` flattens the model parameter, variable and constraint builders—including both loss-constraint branches—still receive the original MultiIndex; the context manager only changes component data access, not `sns`. Thus the required representation is not consistently passed to builders when `"flat"` is selected (including `"auto"` under v1 semantics).
